XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Start&Stop inactive, with activation of the system fault indicator light and ignition of the engine
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | BULB | POWER BRAKES | P0555 | IGNITION | IGNITES | IGNITED | MIL | YELLOW | YELLOW | START | STOP | AVAILABLE | WORKS | WORKING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Brakes

  • Device: Brake booster bulb

  • Fault: The Start&Stop system is inactive and the corresponding system fault warning light comes on; Engine fault warning light on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0555 (Brake booster pressure sensor - Error)

  • Cause: Faulty brake booster bulb

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the brake booster bulb and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located under the brake booster, near the windscreen, in the engine compartment on the driver's side; after replacement, no adjustment was necessary using a self-diagnostic tester.
